name: prompt-polish
description: Before a prompt is sent, Jev decides whether it could be written better; if so, Claude rewrites it and puts it back in the box for review.

threshold.title: Threshold (0 to 1)
threshold.description: Jev's probability that the prompt could be written better at or above which it is held and rewritten. Higher holds fewer prompts.

rewriteModel.title: Rewrite model
rewriteModel.description: The model that rewrites a held prompt, at effort low: haiku is faster and cheaper, sonnet keeps facts and constraints more reliably.
